pages.name: Van Geet: 1...d5 2.e4
pages.notes: Plan 4 suggested Black exploits White's c3 (blocked by the c3-knight), generic overview. Rewritten around 2...dxe4 3.Nxe4, 2...d4 3.Nce2 and transpositions to the French and Caro-Kann.

pages.name: Van Geet: 1...d5 2.e4 dxe4
pages.notes: Overview called it a Scandinavian with colours reversed (it is a Scandinavian-type line with colours as normal); plans generic. Rewritten, with the 3.f3 and 3.d3 gambits.

pages.name: Nimzo-Larsen Attack: English Variation
pages.notes: Plan 1 read the e5-square as a move; American spelling. Rewritten with the brief's set-ups.

pages.name: Bird Opening: Double Duck Formation
pages.notes: Plans had a knight route Ne1-d3 with no knight able to reach e1 that way, no side prefixes, and the bad-bishop point unclear. Rewritten around the e5/e4 outposts, the e-pawn breaks and the Ba3/...Ba6 bishop trades.

pages.name: Bird Opening: Schlechter Gambit
pages.notes: Overview said White accepts a gambit and Black challenges e5 (Black's 2...Nc6 is the gambit); 0-0 notation. Rewritten around 3...g5 and ...g4 against the f3-knight.

pages.name: Bird Opening: Siegener Gambit
pages.notes: Overview said White sacrifices to handle the From Gambit (2.d4 declines it); plans had Nxd4 into the c5-pawn's guard. Rewritten around 4...dxc3 5.Nxc3 and cxd4. Reviewer rejections (4.c3 called a further pawn; d-file called open, it is half-open) fixed and re-reviewed.

pages.name: Bird: 1..Nf6 2.e3
pages.notes: Plan had the impossible queen route Qe1-h4 from d1 with the king on e1; Stonewall set-up with Be2. Rewritten.

pages.name: Bird: 1..Nf6 2.g3
pages.notes: Plan 2 had ...Bg7 neutralising the g2-bishop (different diagonal). Rewritten around ...d5/...c5 and a mirrored ...g6 set-up.

pages.name: Bird: 1..Nf6 2.Nf3 g6 3.g3
pages.notes: Plan had Qe1-h4, which the g3-pawn blocks; plan 4 vague. Rewritten around d3/e4 and the central breaks.

pages.name: Bird: From Gambit, Lasker, 5.d4
pages.notes: Plans named ...Ng6 with no route and a vague g3/h4 idea. Rewritten around 5...g4, ...Qh4+ on the e1-h4 diagonal and 6.Ne5 Bxe5 7.dxe5 Qxd1+.
